titleEn: Split the Array to Make Coprime Products
title: 分割数组使乘积互质
summary: 在某个下标后把数组分成两个非空部分，要求左右所有元素乘积互质，返回最小合法下标或负一。
insight: 左右乘积互质等价于没有质因数同时出现在分割线两侧。先记录每个质因数最后出现的位置；扫描左侧时维护所有已出现质因数的最远末次位置 boundary，只有 i 达到 boundary 时，左侧涉及的质因数才全部封闭。
pitfalls: 只需记录每个数的不同质因数
数字一没有质因数，不扩大边界
链式跨越会持续推远 boundary

solutions.title: 质因数末次位置边界
solutions.idea: 用质因数区间的最远右端判断合法切分。
steps: 分解每个 nums[i]，记录每个质因数的最后下标
i 从零扫描到 n-2，把 nums[i] 的各质因数 last 合并进 boundary

code.java: class Solution { private List<Integer> factors(int input){List<Integer> result=new ArrayList<>();int value=input;for(int factor=2;factor*factor<=value;factor++)if(value%factor==0){result.add(factor);while(value%factor==0)value/=factor;}if(value>1)result.add(value);return result;}public int findValidSplit(int[] nums){Map<Integer,Integer> last=new HashMap<>();for(int i=0;i<nums.length;i++)for(int factor:factors(nums[i]))last.put(factor,i);int boundary=0;for(int i=0;i<nums.length-1;i++){for(int factor:factors(nums[i]))boundary=Math.max(boundary,last.get(factor));if(i==boundary)return i;}return -1;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private fun factors(input:Int):IntArray{var value=input;val result=mutableListOf<Int>();var factor=2;while(factor*factor<=value){if(value%factor==0){result.add(factor);while(value%factor==0)value/=factor};factor++};if(value>1)result.add(value);return result.toIntArray()}fun findValidSplit(nums:IntArray):Int{val last=HashMap<Int,Int>();for(i in nums.indices)for(factor in factors(nums[i]))last[factor]=i;var boundary=0;for(i in 0 until nums.lastIndex){for(factor in factors(nums[i]))boundary=maxOf(boundary,last[factor]!!);if(i==boundary)return i};return -1} }
code.cpp: class Solution { vector<int> factors(int value){vector<int> result;for(int factor=2;factor*factor<=value;++factor)if(value%factor==0){result.push_back(factor);while(value%factor==0)value/=factor;}if(value>1)result.push_back(value);return result;}public:int findValidSplit(vector<int>& nums){unordered_map<int,int> last;for(int i=0;i<(int)nums.size();++i)for(int factor:factors(nums[i]))last[factor]=i;int boundary=0;for(int i=0;i+1<(int)nums.size();++i){for(int factor:factors(nums[i]))boundary=max(boundary,last[factor]);if(i==boundary)return i;}return -1;} };
